traditional: 喺 A 同 B 之間
jyutping: hai2 A tung4 B zi1 gaan1

english.note: Use this as the all-purpose choice for something physically located in, or travelling along the route between, two places or points.

examples.english: This ferry travels between Hong Kong and Macau every day.
examples.traditional: 呢班船每日喺香港同澳門之間來回。
